title: Protein Variant Effect Prediction
selection_rule: Fix all 50 complete original assay queries, then select one highest-mean complete arm/thinking per LLM family. Equal assay weights; no per-assay arm mixing. Preserve the existing five-baseline roster; descriptive same-cohort selection, not held-out validation.
query_size_policy: 50 assays: 48 x N250 + KCNH2 N200 + SCN5A N224; complete original frozen queries, same candidates for every model within each assay. Assay metrics are equally weighted; no resampling or padding.
baseline_note: 50 assays: 48 x N250 + KCNH2 N200 + SCN5A N224; complete original frozen queries, same candidates for every model within each assay. Assay metrics are equally weighted; no resampling or padding.
